finding.title: Localize wizard_steps.dart step text; wizard_steps_l1_test.dart's he-locale tests currently pin the English literals

evidence.quote: expect(find.text('Set delay for each round'), findsOneWidget);

finding.why: Every heading, subtitle, option-card title and day-name label in WizardChooseMethodStep/WizardSelectPresetStep/WizardCustomStep1-3 is a raw Dart string literal — only the Next/Confirm/Days/Weeks CTAs go through AppLocalizations. A Hebrew-speaking parent onboarding a child (the app's core RTL/Hebrew-terms audience) sees raw English through the entire custom-review-builder wizard. Worse, all 4 of the file's own 'Hebrew locale smoke' tests pump the widget under `Locale('he')` and then assert the English string renders (`findsOneWidget`) — so any future engineer who actually localizes these widgets breaks 4 currently-green tests, and CI flags the fix as the regression.
finding.recommendation: Add ARB keys for each literal (curriculumSettingsCustomSchedule already exists for an identical string used elsewhere — reuse or mirror it), wire via AppLocalizations.of(context)!.xxx in wizard_steps.dart, then rewrite the 4 Hebrew-smoke tests to assert the Hebrew ARB value and findsNothing on the former English literal, matching the pattern already used correctly in permission_prompt_screen_l1_test.dart's 'Hebrew l10n (rationale copy)' group.
acceptance_criteria: make arb-parity stays green after new keys are added
wizard_steps_l1_test.dart's 4 he-locale tests assert the Hebrew ARB string and findsNothing on the former English literal
no raw string literal remains in WizardChooseMethodStep/WizardSelectPresetStep/WizardCustomStep1-3 build methods outside AppLocalizations calls
